Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 5
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the WebSurfer’s results by asserting that OTRAG was headquartered/based in Libya, conflating its test operations there with its corporate location. Sources shown indicated OTRAG was a West German company based in Stuttgart (country of origin: Germany). This synthesis error led to the incorrect conclusion that Kaufland (German) and OTRAG (erroneously placed in Libya) were not in the same country, when both are German.
